language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.
Hi! My name is Katie. I am a scientist and I work on Christmas Island. This is my friend Sam. He’s a crab. He and his friends live on the island with me.
Did you know that we have many different kinds of weather here? Maybe it is the same where you are. Can you help me observe our different kinds of weather this week? Yes? Great!

exercises.title: Activities for different types of weather

dialog.text: I would like to know which activities I can do best in different weather conditions. Please help me decide whether a statement is true or false about the different activities.

helperSimple.text: Please help Katie figure out which of the statements are true or false about the suitable activities for different types of weather.

activities.title: Is the statement true or false?

activities.title: Is the statement true or false?

outro.text: Thank you for your help! You cleared up which activities I can and can’t do when it’s windy, cloudy, rainy or sunny.
